findings.detail: C01 counts debt facility rows whose source reference-rate and interest-rate cells are literal dashes and whose cost/fair-value cells are zero or negative unfunded commitment marks.

rationale: C01 failed because only 76.7% of 150 normalized debt rows have an interest rate, but the raw Schedule of Investments explicitly prints dashes, not rates, for sampled missing-rate delayed-draw and revolver rows such as Cytracom and Routeware. Those same issuers/facilities appear in the separate Unfunded Commitment schedule, so the missing rates are source-supported non-coupon commitment rows rather than extraction omissions. The check is therefore scoped too broadly for this filing's debt rows.
